objective: Launch PinkyVaultV2 from this repository on Robinhood Chain as contracts only: no token and no pool. Deploy PinkyVaultV2 with the constructor arguments in launch.json. It is Pinky's second vault, beside the live PinkyVault, and reuses the live PINKY token and PinkyStaking from launch #1166. A holder bonds IMD behind one of four promises about their own wallet (Keep, Pay, Hold, Moves), optionally made to a beneficiary; after the term settle buys the IdentityMD oracle's answer through Intake version 2 with requestWithFailure, paid from the bond, and payout pays the bond on the verdict, with a 1% fee to PinkyStaking on bonds that go home or to a beneficiary. The owner's settings change only through proposals applied after seven days. Keep the contracts as they are unless the launch requires a change.
